corrections.text: The headline says 'Maintainers Estimate 25% of Incoming Pull Requests Are "AI Slop"' and cites a '35%' share of projects with a 'Formal GenAI Policy'. The Linux Foundation press release says only that 25% of incoming PRs 'are estimated to be low-quality, also known as "AI slop"' without stating who made the estimate, and that 'Only 35% of projects have a formal policy permitting GenAI use'. The sources also do not state the survey sample size or how 'AI slop' was defined.
